name: Haze of Evil
label: Quest
description: Haze of Evil: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: To tell you the truth, friend, I've never seen any plants like this in my travels. Perhaps I should take a trip to this crater...
At any rate, I think I know just the thing Muigin's looking for -- Atal'ai haze. It's horrid stuff, hard to collect, but it's just what he needs to control the little monsters.
You'll need to visit the temple of Atal'Hakkar in the Swamp of Sorrows. The Atal'ai Haze can be collected from the deep lurkers, murk worms, or oozes found there. Good luck, friend!

clips.title: Progress
paras: Larion's still not speaking to me! He sure knows how to hold a grudge.

clips.title: Completion
paras: I admit, I'm a bit hesitant to touch that stuff, friend! But if Gregan says it'll work, then I'm willing to give it a try!
